mapper.sql: create_time, create_by, create_pg_id, update_time, update_by, update_pg_id, version
mapper.select:
select item_code as itemCode, item_name as itemName, prztic from mast_item where item_code in
#{itemCode}

select d.id as id, d.item_code as itemCode, d.item_name as itemName, d.classification as category, d.qty as storageQty, d.pallet_no as palletNo, d.status as status, concat(coalesce(nullif(mw.wh_nm, ''), d.wh_cd), '/', d.loc_cd) as storagePlace from bss_inventory_detail d left join mast_warehouse mw on mw.wh_cd = d.wh_cd where d.delete_flg = '0' and d.pallet_no = #{palletNo} order by d.item_code
mapper.sql: ( select coalesce(nullif(su.nick_name, ''), d2.update_by) from bss_inventory_detail d2 left join sys_user su on su.user_name = d2.update_by where d2.delete_flg = '0' and d2.wh_cd = d.wh_cd and d2.loc_cd = d.loc_cd and d2.item_code = d.item_code order by d2.update_time desc nulls last limit 1 )
mapper.select: select d.item_code as itemCode, max(d.item_name) as itemName, max(coalesce(nullif(cl.dict_label, ''), d.classification)) as classification, sum(d.qty) as quantity, to_char(max(d.update_time), 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') as updatedAt, ( select coalesce(nullif(su.nick_name, ''), d2.update_by) from bss_inventory_detail d2 left join sys_user su on su.user_name = d2.update_by where d2.delete_flg = '0' and d2.item_code = d.item_code order by d2.update_time desc nulls last limit 1 ) as updater from bss_inventory_detail d left join sys_dict_data cl on cl.dict_type = 'bss_classification' and cl.dict_value = d.classification where d.delete_flg = '0' and d.item_code = #{itemCode} group by d.item_code

select cast(d.id as varchar) as id, d.pallet_no as palletNo, coalesce(nullif(mw.wh_nm, ''), d.wh_cd) as warehouse, coalesce(nullif(st.dict_label, ''), pnd.storage_type) as storageType, d.qty as quantity, coalesce(nullif(uf.dict_label, ''), pnd.usable_flag) as usable, pnd.remarks as remark from bss_inventory_detail d left join bss_pallet_number_detail pnd on pnd.pallet_no = d.pallet_no and pnd.item_code = d.item_code and pnd.delete_flg = '0' left join mast_warehouse mw on mw.wh_cd = d.wh_cd left join sys_dict_data st on st.dict_type = 'bss_pallet_storage_type' and st.dict_value = pnd.storage_type left join sys_dict_data uf on uf.dict_type = 'sys_usable_flag' and uf.dict_value = pnd.usable_flag where d.delete_flg = '0' and d.item_code = #{itemCode} order by d.pallet_no

select cast(h.id as varchar) as id, h.pallet_no as palletNo, nullif(pn.storage_period, '') as storagePeriod, concat(coalesce(nullif(mw.wh_nm, ''), h.wh_cd), ' ', h.loc_cd) as place, coalesce(nullif(hs.dict_label, ''), h.status) as status, coalesce(nullif(mw.wh_nm, ''), h.wh_cd) as warehouse, h.storage_qty as quantity, h.used_qty as usedQty, h.lost_damaged_qty as lostQty, nullif(substring(h.transfer_datetime from 1 for 16), '') as moveAt, nullif(h.transfer_request_no, '') as requestNo, nullif(substring(h.request_datetime from 1 for 16), '') as requestAt, h.requester as requester, coalesce(nullif(substring(h.io_datetime from 1 for 16), ''), to_char(h.update_time, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI')) as updatedAt, coalesce(nullif(su.nick_name, ''), h.update_by) as updater from bss_inventory_history h left join bss_pallet_number pn on pn.pallet_no = h.pallet_no and pn.delete_flg = '0' left join mast_warehouse mw on mw.wh_cd = h.wh_cd left join sys_dict_data hs on hs.dict_type = 'bss_inventory_hist_status' and hs.dict_value = h.status left join sys_user su on su.user_name = h.update_by where h.item_code = #{itemCode} order by h.pallet_no, h.update_time

select coalesce(nullif(mw.wh_nm, ''), d.wh_cd) as warehouse, d.loc_cd as location, coalesce(nullif(su.nick_name, ''), d.update_by) as updater, to_char(d.update_time, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') as updatedAt from bss_inventory_detail d left join mast_warehouse mw on mw.wh_cd = d.wh_cd left join sys_user su on su.user_name = d.update_by where d.delete_flg = '0' and d.wh_cd = #{whCd} and d.loc_cd = #{locCd} order by d.update_time desc nulls last limit 1

select cast(d.id as varchar) as id, d.pallet_no as palletNo, nullif(pn.storage_period, '') as storagePeriod, d.item_code as itemCode, d.item_name as itemName, coalesce(nullif(st.dict_label, ''), pnd.storage_type) as storageType, d.qty as quantity, coalesce(nullif(uf.dict_label, ''), pnd.usable_flag) as usable from bss_inventory_detail d left join bss_pallet_number pn on pn.pallet_no = d.pallet_no and pn.delete_flg = '0' left join bss_pallet_number_detail pnd on pnd.pallet_no = d.pallet_no and pnd.item_code = d.item_code and pnd.delete_flg = '0' left join sys_dict_data st on st.dict_type = 'bss_pallet_storage_type' and st.dict_value = pnd.storage_type left join sys_dict_data uf on uf.dict_type = 'sys_usable_flag' and uf.dict_value = pnd.usable_flag where d.delete_flg = '0' and d.wh_cd = #{whCd} and d.loc_cd = #{locCd} order by d.pallet_no, d.item_code
